title: avenor spawn input
description: The one place a spawn field's name, type, and description is written: the Go MCP server publishes a filtered copy of it, and the JavaScript surfaces build their field text from it, so a field is renamed or reworded once. `required` is deliberately absent: which fields a caller must supply is a per-surface fact, and each surface keeps its own list. `x-avenor-surfaces` names the surfaces that publish the field, so a test can hold every surface to this file instead of to a remembered list.

x-avenor-surface-descriptions.go: The spawn tool's input schema: every field this server accepts, with the fields only the JavaScript surfaces publish removed. Required names the fields the decoder cannot default, and additionalProperties false refuses any other key. Compiled from schemas/spawn.input.json.

agent.description: Optional agent persona; the backend resolves this name to a prompt, tool set, and permission policy. Independent of model and backend: supply any of the three, or none. Rejected when roster_entry is set, because the entry names all three.

repo_dir.description: Required. Working directory for the run.

dir.description: Working directory for the run, under the name the pi and OpenCode surfaces use for repo_dir. Defaults to the session directory.

prompt.description: Initial prompt text. Supply it or prompt_file.

prompt_file.description: Path to a file holding the initial prompt. Supply it or prompt.

timeout.description: Timeout as a duration string or seconds, such as 90s, 5m, or 1h.

model.description: Optional model override; independent of agent and backend, so a model can be named alone. Combined with agent, it runs that persona on this model. Rejected when roster_entry is set; to run a roster persona on a different model, send the identity directly.

thinking.description: Reasoning level: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Omission uses the backend default; a backend that supports no level rejects an explicit value.

backend.description: Optional runtime backend, such as agy, pi, opencode-acp, codex-app-server, claude, or poo. Independent of agent and model. Omission uses the surface's default: pi on the pi extension, opencode-acp elsewhere. Rejected when roster_entry is set.

roster_file.description: Optional path to a roster map; pair it with roster_entry to select a whole loadout by key. Setting roster_entry turns on roster mode, which rejects agent, model, and backend.

roster_entry.description: Optional roster entry key; the selected entry supplies backend, agent, and model as one identity, and its optional thinking is only a default. Requires roster_file. Passing agent, model, or backend alongside it is an error; to change one part of a roster persona, send the identity directly instead.

server_url.description: Backend server URL, required by opencode-http unless the environment configures it.

supervisor_id.description: Supervisor socket path to use instead of the default. Must be an avenor-mcp-*.sock directly inside the sockets root (AVENOR_HOME/sockets when set, otherwise ~/.avenor/sockets).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key; a retry with the same key and parameters returns the original run instead of spawning a second one.

launch_wrapper.description: Optional argv prefix; disabled unless the selected supervisor enables an operator allowlist. Must exactly match an approved argv array. No shell expansion.

auto_approve.description: Optional auto-approve all permission requests so the run executes unattended (no answer_permission needed).

persist_sessions.description: Persist the run's backend session (pi: a session directory instead of --no-session), so the transcript outlives the process and a later one can resume it. Omitted inherits the supervisor's AVENOR_PI_SESSIONS setting; true and false force the choice for this run.

messaging.description: Optional let a poo child send and receive Avenor messages; defaults on for a delegation spawn, and off for a workflow node, a loop or team phase, and a permission-decider run.

wait.description: Block until the run completes, showing live progress; false returns at once with the run id.
